description: We're Kavya and Shubh from Surat. We love turning raw NASA data into tools people can use: strong in Python, data analysis and web dashboards. We're tackling Lunar Landing Site Navigator, predicting sunlight and Earth contact at lunar south-pole sites with real NASA terrain data. Join us for serious science and a team that aims to win. Looking for: UI/UX design, video editing and storytelling, presenting, and any space science background.
